name: OpenTripPlanner
description: Multi-modal transit trip planning via OpenTripPlanner

dataSources.purpose: Multi-modal transit trip planning via self-hosted OpenTripPlanner. Coverage depends on loaded data.
dataSources.dataSent: Origin and destination coordinates, time, date, travel mode, number of itineraries, optional arrive-by flag
dataSources.dataReceived: Itineraries with duration, transfers, walk distance, legs with mode, route, encoded polyline geometry, intermediate stops
